note: Current consumer-local receipt objects, not a new Host API/schema or proof of real execution. Runtime paths and secret values are not included.

fragments.name: generationBinding
fragments.expression:
recovery ? {
      version: 1, requestId: recovery.requestId, requestBodySha256: sha256(init.body),
      selectedModel: 'miaoda/glm-5.3', codexBinary: options.codexBinary,
      configPath: options.configPath, promptSha256: sha256(prompt),
      timeoutSeconds, maxOutputTokens: request.max_output_tokens,
      reasoningEffort: request.reasoning_effort,
    } : null

fragments.name: codexReceipt
programReceiptLinks
fragments.expression:
{
    assessmentBinding: hostBinding, modelRequestId: codexRecoveryRequestId, modelArgsHash: argsHash,
    modelResponseSha256: responseRecord.value.codexReceipt.responseSha256,
    runDirectory: responseRecord.value.codexReceipt.runDirectory,
    transportSummaryRef: responseRecord.value.codexReceipt.transportSummaryRef,
    saveRequestId: saveRequest.requestId, workRevisionRef: revision.workRevisionRef,
    workRevision: revision.workRevision, independentReadCheckpoint: 'program-work-readback',
  }
